description:

Preserve exactly:
- fixture names: multi_tool, no_tool, tool_round_trip_1, tool_round_trip_2
- tool definitions and callbacks
- forced-tool-choice fallback behavior
- model capability guards for tools and forced choice

Expected behavior: replay existing tool fixtures without live re-recording.

Proof target: replay representative OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI-compatible provider tool slices where fixtures already exist.
title: Extract tool and conversation scenarios
